title: Register Note on Protection Already Credited Within the Year
content:
Where downside protection has already been credited on an account under Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts within the year, part or all of what was credited is set against the credit now being worked out. How much is set against it turns on how many credits already stand on the account in the twelve months ending on the handling date, taken together with the gallons booked.

1. Where 2 or more protection credits already stand on the account in the twelve months ending on the handling date and the gallons booked reach twice the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons, the whole of the protection already credited in that window is set against the credit.
2. Where 1 protection credit stands on the account in that window and the gallons booked reach the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons, the protection already credited in that window taken at a share of 0.5 is set against the credit, that share being taken to two decimal places.
3. In every other case nothing already credited is set against the credit.

**What the money figure is.** It is the money credited as downside protection on the account over the twelve months ending on the handling date, taken as a positive figure however it stands on the account.

## The lines, as conditions and results

| Credits already standing in the window | Gallons booked | Set against the credit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2 or more | At or above twice the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons | The whole of the protection credited in the window |
| 2 or more | Below twice the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons | Nothing |
| Exactly 1 | At or above the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons | The protection credited in the window at a share of 0.5 |
| Exactly 1 | Below the programme's minimum pre-buy gallons | Nothing |
| None | Any figure | Nothing |

*Hypothetical.* An account carries 2 protection credits in the window coming to 180.00 USD between them, and gallons booked standing at twice the programme's minimum exactly. The whole 180.00 USD is set against the credit. Had only 1 credit stood in the window, of 180.00 USD, with gallons booked at the programme's minimum, then 90.00 USD would be set against it. Had no credit stood in the window, nothing would be.
